caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular frame centered on an off-white background. The frame consists of multiple bands in shades of red, pink, tan, brown, and green, with a scalloped pattern on the inner border. Inside the central portion of the rectangle, there is a vine-like plant with curling brown stems, three grape clusters composed of small round purple circles, and four broad-edged leaves in shades of turquoise-green with brown outlines and accents. The main background within the central rectangle is pinkish-purple. The outermost edges of the frame include broader stripes in red, tan-yellow, green, and brown. The drawing is composed using watercolor or gouache, with visible brush strokes and some color blending and shading in the various sections.
title: Detail of Panel from Reredos, Church of Sanctuario at Chimayo
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
